source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once per battle, as your opponent's turn ends, you can take the bearer's unit off the battlefield and put it into **Strategic Reserves**, provided no enemy unit is within **Engagement Range** of it. Only a **DEATHWING** model may take it.

effects.condition: no enemy unit is in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit
effects.effect: take the bearer's unit off the battlefield into Strategic Reserves

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Lion’s Blade Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
